slices.focus: Sustained results earn Jae-hyun company-wide handoff system authority.
slices.summary: Three straight months with only one avoidable missed cargo window each convinces Kim Dong-wook to grant Jae-hyun company-wide authority to use the signed turnover sheet and common board on all short-haul departures. Jae-hyun feels vindicated but wary of fake compliance, planning a one-page minimum standard, anonymized examples of usable vs unusable handoffs, and a one-month checkpoint.
